description.value: Clearwater Lake Tours operates a café and boat tour/rental service at the Clearwater Lake Campground, 68km into Wells Gray Provincial Park via Clearwater Valley Road. In business for over 30 years, they offer guided wilderness boat tours to destinations like Rainbow Falls, canoe and kayak rentals, and water taxi service to remote wilderness campsites. Their sustainability commitment includes solar power, micro-hydro electricity, and an electric Duffy boat for shorter lake tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms a café ('Our Office – Café' is located at the Clearwater Lake Campground') and exactly matches the OSM phone number (250) 674-2121. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill services are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by the website, so Wi-Fi is marked null per the rules.
concerns: OSM name:en tag shows 'Osprey Café / Clearwater Lake Tours', suggesting the café component operates under a separate name (Osprey Café) not reflected in the primary OSM name field.
Address on file is a PO Box (Box 507, Clearwater); physical location is at Clearwater Lake Campground, 68km from Hwy 5 on Clearwater Valley Road — no civic street address available.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag not corroborated by website content.
Website copyright dated 2020; content may not be fully current.
OSM seasonal=summer confirmed by website (winter: closed); primarily a warm-season operation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate café and services hub deep in Wells Gray Provincial Park; a meaningful stop and destination for touring cyclists riding the Clearwater Valley Road into the park.
enrichment_extras.notes: Primary business is boat tours and rentals; café is a secondary service operated from the same office. Location deep in a provincial park means this listing is most relevant to cyclists specifically exploring Wells Gray Park rather than passing through on a highway route.
